instruction.text: A ladder is leaning against a wall. The ladder is 5 metres long and touches the ground 1.4 metres away from the wall. What angle does the ladder make with the wall? Give your answer to two decimal places.
Two friends are sledging down a slope. The slope is 13.5 metres long and 7 metres tall. What angle is the gradient of the slope? Give your answer to two decimal places.

A clarinet is leaning against a wall. The clarinet is 66 centimetres tall. Its base is 17 centimetres from the wall. What angle does the clarinet make with the wall? Give your answer to two decimal places.

Ali is skating on ramps in the skate park. His favourite ramp is 5 metres long and 3 metres high. If the ramp is in the form of a right-angled triangle, what angle does it make with the floor? Give your answer to two decimal places.
